description: Entry criteria, approval and convergence rules for the spec-first change path (#178). Routine work stays code-first. Cezar and the GitHub lifecycle remain the only scheduler and state owner; this file only decides which path a change takes and what evidence may close it.

codeFirst.note: A code-first type stays code-first unless it declares a contract kind or touches a protected asset.

approval.note: Approval is requested only for a spec-first change; it never gates risk level alone, and the approver is checked by the lifecycle's owner role.

convergence.note: Verified means every contract item has passing test or acceptance evidence. An agent statement is never evidence.
